items.title: Stock Radar: Dabur India stock showing signs of bottoming out after falling by about 30% from highs; time to buy?
items.description: Dabur India rebounded from Rs 350–360 levels and reclaimed its 20-DMA, while a Supertrend buy signal and positive EMA crossover supported improving momentum. Analysts cited a channel breakout, volume and MACD confirmation, with a potential Rs 500 target over 4-6 months.

items.title: US Market: Financial stocks slide as AI disruption, bond curve weigh on banks
items.description: US financial stocks fell sharply as investors weighed AI-driven disruption risks, uncertainty around AI-linked IPOs and a flatter Treasury yield curve. The S&P 500 Financial index dropped 2%, with money managers and banks among the biggest decliners.

items.title: Rajesh Exports, 9 other Nifty 500 stocks tumble up to 60% in 2026. How many do you own?
items.description: The market rout has hit several stocks hard, with some counters falling more than 60% so far this year. The selling pressure has also extended across longer time frames, with a number of stocks recording steep declines over the past one and three years. Here’s the full list of top 10 Nifty 500 laggards.

items.title: Ather Energy among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of September 22, four stocks in the NSE F&O saw recorded a rise of more than 10% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This can reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of existing positions.

items.title: Cyient among 3 stocks closed above VWAP
items.description: On September 22, three Nifty500 stocks closed more than 2% above their respective VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When a stock closes above its VWAP, it indicates that the closing price was higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the session. VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: RBL Bank among 4 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
items.description: On September 22, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level toward the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: Voltas share price: Nuvama upgrades rating but Jefferies cuts target price after analyst meet. Here’s why
items.description: Shares of Voltas received mixed brokerages calls after the company’s analyst meet. Nuvama upgraded the stock to ‘Hold’ but cut its target to Rs 1,220, while Jefferies retained ‘Buy’ and lowered its target to Rs 1,495. Margin pressures, rising costs and market-share gains remain key factors for investors.

items.title: 5 Adani group stocks in focus as firms settle Sebi proceedings linked to Hindenburg report
items.description: Five Adani Group companies have settled Sebi proceedings over alleged disclosure and corporate governance violations, paying a combined Rs 1.51 crore. The proceedings relate to findings arising from Sebi’s examination of issues highlighted in the Hindenburg Report.

items.title: 360 ONE WAM shares rise over 2% after appointing Jefferies India Head and MD as new CEO
items.description: 360 ONE WAM appoints Jefferies India Country Head Aashish Agarwal as Group CEO, with founders Karan Bhagat and Yatin Shah taking focused leadership roles across strategy and wealth management.

items.title: Gabriel India among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On September 22, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 5% appeared on the RSI Trending Up scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.An uptrend signal occurs when the RSI crosses above 50 from below. RSI Trending Up indicates that the Relative Strength Index values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price. RSI is a technical indicator commonly used to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: SS Retail shares make strong D-Street debut, list at 51% premium over IPO price
items.description: The Rs 500 crore SS Retail IPO comprised a fresh issue of 85.08 lakh shares aggregating to Rs 360 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 33.02 lakh shares worth Rs 140 crore. The company had fixed the IPO price band at Rs 403–Rs 424 per share, with a lot size of 35 shares.

items.title: Hero Motors shares list at 2% discount on IPO price
items.description: The Rs 1,000 crore Hero Motors IPO was a book-built issue comprising a fresh issue of 7.14 crore shares aggregating to Rs 600 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 4.76 crore shares worth Rs 400 crore. The IPO was priced in the range of Rs 79–Rs 84 per share, with a minimum lot size of 178 shares.

items.title: Jindal Supreme shares list at 31% premium over IPO price on BSE
items.description: The Rs 124.88 crore Jindal Supreme IPO comprised a fresh issue of 1.07 crore shares aggregating to Rs 99.89 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 26.87 lakh shares worth Rs 24.99 crore. The company had fixed the IPO price band at Rs 88–93 per share.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 5 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, five stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on September 22, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Aashish Agarwal named CEO of 360 ONE WAM Group
items.description: Wealth and asset management firm 360 ONE has appointed Aashish Agarwal as chief executive officer of 360 ONE WAM Group, according to a release. Agarwal joins the company from Jefferies, where he was MD and country head since April 2020. Karan Bhagat, currently MD and CEO, will become vice chairman and continue as managing director.

items.title: D-St braces for weak opening on negative GIFT Nifty cues
items.description: Benchmark indices faced pressure and closed negatively on Tuesday.  The Nifty is expected to continue its consolidation in a broad range.  Foreign portfolio investors were net sellers, while domestic investors bought shares.  The Indian Rupee appreciated against the US dollar on Tuesday.  Several stocks were placed under the F&O ban for Tuesday's trading.

items.title: Stocks in news: Adani Group, OMCs, Persistent Systems and IRB Infra
items.description: The Indian stock market closed lower on Tuesday, with profit-taking affecting investor sentiment. Adani Group companies resolved their SEBI adjudication issues tied to potential infractions. Focus turned to oil marketing firms in light of a sharp fall in crude oil prices. Persistent Systems expanded its stake in Nagarro, eyeing a potential delisting, alongside numerous companies announcing expansion and corporate milestones.

items.title: Stocks to buy: Jefferies lists 11 NBFC picks with up to 48% upside potential. Do you own any?
items.description: Jefferies assigns ‘Buy’ calls to 11 non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), with target prices implying up to 48% upside potential. It also has ‘Hold’ ratings on Mahindra Finance, LIC Housing Finance, Bajaj Housing Finance, SBI Cards, Muthoot Finance, Piramal Finance and IIFL Finance.The brokerage hosted nine of the companies and found that most reported healthy disbursement growth and resilient asset quality in the July-September quarter so far. Cost of funds (CoF) remains steady but could inch up if the RBI raises rates, while most companies expect net interest margins (NIMs) to remain range-bound in the near term.

items.title: SS Retail shares rally another 6% after bumper listing at 51% premium over IPO price. Buy, sell or hold?
items.description: SS Retail shares extended gains after a bumper debut, rising over 6% following a 50.73% listing premium on the BSE. With the stock trading at around 46.5x FY26 P/E, Swastika Investmart maintained a Neutral view, citing demanding valuations and limited margin of safety despite strong growth and profitability.

items.title: Hero Motors shares hit 20% upper circuit after lackluster debut. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Hero Motors shares staged a dramatic recovery on Wednesday, surging 20% to hit the upper circuit at Rs 98.40 after listing at a 2% discount at Rs 82. Despite strong IPO demand, analysts recommend holding existing shares with a stop-loss or waiting for price consolidation before taking fresh positions.

items.title: Meesho shares drop 4% after block deal worth Rs 900 crore. Should you buy the dip?
items.description: Meesho shares witnessed a dip on Wednesday after 3.86 crore shares changed hands in a block deal worth Rs 899.71 crore on the BSE. The transaction came a day after the stock surged nearly 10% following UBS’ 24% target price hike.

items.title: Clean Max shares surge 13% in 3 days as Macquarie initiates coverage with outperform rating
items.description: Clean Max shares: Macquarie initiated coverage on Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions with an Outperform rating and a Rs 1,700 target price, implying 24% upside from current levels. The stock has gained 13% in three sessions, making Macquarie the second brokerage to initiate coverage after JM Financial.

items.title: Sensex jumps 350 points, Nifty above 23,400 as oil dips below $99/barrel. What can trigger the next sharp rally on D-Street?
items.description: Indian benchmark indices gain up to 0.5% as metal and financial stocks support the market, while elevated crude prices and bond yields remain key constraints. Analysts highlight resistance levels and stretched midcap and smallcap valuations.

items.title: 10 midcap stocks that soared up to 105% in 6 months; check FII and MF holdings
items.description: Over the last six months, the Nifty 50 index has been a flat performer, gaining just under 1%, while the Nifty Midcap 150 index has delivered a 13% gain. But the real story lies beneath the surface. Several midcap stocks significantly outperformed the broader index, posting remarkable gains during the same period. As many as 33 midcap stocks have rallied more than 25% over the past six months. Of these, 10 stocks have soared between 50% and 105%, emerging as the standout performers in the segment. We also examined how key institutional investors, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and mutual funds (MFs), were positioned in these high-performing stocks during the June 2026 quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: UBS upgrades Bajaj Finance shares, LT Finance as it sees NBFCs better placed than banks. Here’s why
items.description: UBS upgraded Bajaj Finance to Neutral and L&T Finance to Buy, citing improving asset quality and a revival in unsecured lending. The brokerage sees scope for re-rating as personal loan growth accelerates, liquidity remains supportive and funding conditions stay favourable. It also expects improving return on assets across select NBFCs.

items.title: Bajaj Finance shares jump 3% after UBS upgrades to Neutral, hikes target price while Jefferies screams Buy
items.description: Bajaj Finance shares jumped 3% on Wednesday following bullish brokerage calls. Global brokerages Jefferies and UBS issued positive outlooks, with Jefferies maintaining a Buy rating with a target of Rs 1,280, while UBS upgraded the stock to Neutral with a target price of Rs 1,100.

items.title: Stocks to buy: Jefferies remains bullish on these 4 capital market stocks, sees up to 36% upside
items.description: Capital market stocks have seen sharp upswings and downswings recently amid worries around the newly-introduced closing auction session (CAS). The much-awaited initial public offering of NSE also was one of the key factors watched by investors in this space. Jefferies has a ‘Buy’ call on four capital market stocks with target prices implying up to 36% upside potential, although the international brokerage has an ‘Underperform’ call on BSE and ‘Hold’ rating on CDSL shares.

items.title: Sensex crossed 85K for first time 2 years ago, now down 10K points from milestone. What can trigger the next bull run?
items.description: Two years ago, Sensex soared to an impressive 85,000, but the market has seen a steep decline since then. This downturn is attributed to several factors, including high crude oil prices and geopolitical instability. Analysts believe a change in macroeconomic conditions could help the index bounce back, relying heavily on the performance of large-cap stocks and improved earnings. Investors should be discerning, focusing on high-quality stocks in this challenging environment.

items.title: Ola Electric shares soar 10%, stock rallies 86% in 6 months. More upside ahead?
items.description: Ola Electric shares surged nearly 10%, extending their three-session rally and gaining over 86% in six months from the March low. Brokerages, however, remain cautious amid weak volumes, lower margins and continued cash burn.

items.title: Arvind SmartSpaces shares rally 11% as bookings cross Rs 500 crore in Bengaluru project
items.description: Arvind SmartSpaces shares surged 10.83% after its Bengaluru project, Arvind Sylva – The Green Reserve, crossed Rs 500 crore in bookings within 30 days, achieving 60% value-based absorption. Located on Sarjapur Road, the premium project spans 4.7 acres with 375 residences. The stock has also shown strong recent momentum.

items.title: Gautam Adani reclaims richest Indian spot from Mukesh Ambani as India's billionaire count hits record: Hurun
items.description: Gautam Adani has overtaken Mukesh Ambani to reclaim the top spot on the M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026, with wealth of Rs 9.23 lakh crore. The list now includes a record 391 dollar billionaires, while AI and quantum computing have emerged as new wealth-creation sectors and 70% of entrants are self-made entrepreneurs.

items.title: NTPC pays Rs 3,393.83 crore final dividend for FY26; total payout reaches Rs 8,727 crore
items.description: NTPC Ltd has declared a final dividend of Rs 3,393.83 crore, contributing to a total of Rs 8,727 crore for the financial year 2025-26. This dividend represents 35 percent of the company's paid-up equity share capital. The company has now paid dividends for 33 consecutive years to its shareholders. NTPC aims to increase its generation capacity from over 91 GW to 149 GW by 2032.

items.title: Anlon Healthcare among 7 healthcare stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 105% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex closed 299 points higher at 74,828 on Wednesday. Amid the market rally, seven stocks from the BSE Healthcare Index hit fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous 12 months and can indicate increased market activity and investor interest.

items.title: Sebi weighs lower margins for longer-term derivatives as F&O losses stay high: Tuhin Kanta Pandey
items.description: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the regulator is examining whether margin requirements can be lowered for longer-term derivatives contracts. The move could support deeper markets while Sebi continues addressing high retail F&O losses and speculative short-term trading.

items.title: Cupid raises FY27 profit guidance, targets Rs 750 crore revenue; stock up 160% in 2026
items.description: Cupid Limited raised its FY27 guidance to Rs 725-750 crore revenue and Rs 210-225 crore net profit after strong June-quarter growth. Revenue rose 142% and profit 194%, while expansion in manufacturing, consumer distribution and international healthcare supports its medium-term growth plans.

items.title: EV story in auto ancillaries is known. A second change could matter more: 5 auto ancillary stocks, 3 with upside potential of 9% to 24%
items.description: What actually is an auto component company? If you forget the fact that it makes car parts, what you have is a precision-engineering business. It makes metal parts to very fine tolerances, to a consistent standard, in large numbers, day after day. That skill, the ability to make a crucial part correctly every single time, is the real asset. That the part happens to go into a car is almost incidental.

items.title: Market wrap: Bajaj Finance, Tata Steel, HCL Tech, Titan Company top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks ended higher on Wednesday, with Nifty rising 0.50% and Sensex gaining 0.40% as buying emerged across sectors. Metal stocks led the gains, while IT stocks lagged. Bajaj Finance and Tata Steel topped the gainers, while HCL Tech and Titan Company featured among the biggest losers.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: How India’s biggest investors are hunting for the next alpha
items.description: As large investors look beyond traditional equities and debt, private credit, venture debt, co-investments and alternative strategies are gaining attention. At ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, leading experts will explore how family offices and institutions are deploying capital and what their approach could mean for retail investors.

items.title: Whirlpool of India stock soars 20% to hit upper circuit on promoter stake sale buzz
items.description: Whirlpool of India shares surged 20% to hit the upper circuit at Rs 865.35 after reports indicated promoter Whirlpool Mauritius may sell its entire remaining 39.76% stake. The potential stake sale, reportedly involving major investors and a multinational consumer durables company, follows years of promoter stake reduction and drove strong buying interest.
